sentences.en: The song of Dongfanghong sings the ictus of epoch and aspirations of hundreds of millions of people. Not only sing in China , but also sing in the world as the first music into the space by China.

sentences.en: Conclusion:The ictus treatment of large dose methylprednisolone is superior to routine hormonotherapy in therapeutic effect.

sentences.en: Increased T2 signal is seen in inferior olives one month post ictus but hypertrophy is observed by 4-6 months and resolves after 3-4 years.
